blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.
blocks.zh: 数据分配方法经常使用一个小的代理模型来选择培训数据,用于更大的目标模型. 然而,这个代理可以对数据进行与目标不同的排序,导致培训表现不理想. 为了解决这一问题,我们模拟代理模式与目标模式之间的不匹配,并将其纳入分配决定. 为此,问题被铸成多信仰的强盗,每个臂都是数据干预. 代理奖赏每轮都遵守,而目标奖赏则只在对相同更新的罕见审计中披露. 这些对齐的观测发现臂与臂的错配,而不假设共享相抵或保留排名. 错失校正的匪徒会用配对的残余来纠正代理,审计只有不确定的决定,审计预算速度会比培训更快. 从理论上来说,我们证明了一种遗憾的分解和在站立性下的下限。 这些界限表明,只有代理分配才能引起线性遗憾,必须至少进行对等审计。 在突然变化的情况下,及早使用审计预算也可能造成线性遗憾。 将审计分散于培训的滑入窗口政策对订单$\sqrt\T造成遗憾 T\log T} $ 表示变化点数的美元 。 在Civil Pops-WILDS上,我们通过一个封闭式的概念证明来测试这个方法,BERT-Small指导BERT-Large的训练. 错误的校正提高了最差组的准确性,优于具有相同目标模式预算的仅标政策. 对培训进行分散审计,使最坏群体的准确性在同一审计点上提高了6.3至10.5个百分点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models are trained on heterogeneous mixtures of web text, code, books, dialogue, and domain- or language-specific collections, and the way the optimization budget is distributed across these sources shapes the capabilities of the final model. Because the effect of a data choice on a large model is expensive to measure, most allocation methods rely on a cheaper signal: a small proxy model, a reference model, or training-time statistics Xie et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2025) ; Albalak et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2025) . The implicit assumption is that this signal ranks the candidate data as the target model would.
blocks.zh: 语言模型接受关于网络文本、代码、书籍、对话以及域或语言特有集合的多种混合的培训,优化预算在这些来源之间的分配方式将塑造最终模型的能力。 由于数据选择对大型模型的影响是昂贵的来衡量,所以大多数分配方法都依赖于更便宜的信号:一个小型的代理模型,一个参考模型,或者训练时间统计 Xie等 (2023年);刘等 (2025年); Albalak等 (2023年); Chen等 (2025年). 隐含的假设是,这个信号将候选数据排在目标模型的后列.

blocks.en: This assumption can fail even when the proxy is informative. A proxy may be accurate on average and still attribute the largest gains to the wrong data, because its error depends on the data group. In our proof of concept, the rewards of a BERT-Small proxy and of a BERT-Large target are positively correlated, yet about one third of the per-round gains have opposite signs for the two models. A policy that trusts the proxy can then estimate its own signal very precisely while repeatedly favoring data helping the proxy rather than the target.
blocks.zh: 即使代理信息丰富,这个假设也可能失败. 一个代理可能平均准确,仍然将最大的收益归因于错误的数据,因为它的错误取决于数据组. 在我们的概念证明中,BERT-Small代理和BERT-Large目标的回报是正相关联的,然而大约三分之一的每轮收益对两种模式有相反的迹象. 一个信任代理的政策,然后可以非常准确地估计自己的信号,同时再三倾向于帮助代理而不是目标的数据.

blocks.en: We study this problem as a multi-fidelity bandit (Figure 1 ). Each arm represents a data intervention. After every update, the controller observes the proxy reward. On rare audited updates, it also observes the target reward for the same intervention and update. In our proof of concept, one audit means evaluating BERT-Large (335M parameters) on 20,005 validation examples, against BERT-Small (28.8M) on 2,001 examples for the proxy. Pairing the two observations makes the proxy error identifiable arm by arm: instead of replacing the proxy with sparse target feedback, the audits estimate the residual between the two signals and correct the ranking induced by the proxy. Multi-fidelity bandits assume that the bias of each fidelity is bounded by a known constant Kandasamy et al. (2016) , and bandits with sparse and noisy feedback assume an offset common to all arms Bouneffouf et al. (2025) . Our setting makes neither assumption: the proxy–target mismatch may vary across arms and can therefore reverse their ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们作为多信仰强盗来研究这个问题(图1). 每个臂代表数据干预。 每次更新后,控制者都会遵守代理奖励. 在罕见的经审计的更新中,它也观察到同一干预和更新的目标奖励. 在我们的概念证明中,一项审计是指在20 005个验证实例上评价BERT-Large(335M参数),在2 001个代理实例上评价BERT-Small(28.8M)。 对等两个观察使代理错误通过手臂可以识别臂:审计不是用稀少的目标反馈来取代代理,而是估计两个信号之间的剩余部分,并纠正由代理引起的排名. 多信仰的土匪认为,每个忠贞的偏见都与已知的常数Kandasamy等人(2016年)相接;而反馈少而吵闹的土匪则认为,所有武器Boneffouf等人(2025年)都有共同的抵消。 我们的设定不作任何假设:代理-目标不匹配可能因武器而异,因此可以逆转它们的排名。

blocks.en: A second question then arises: when should audits be spent? If the relation between proxy and target were fixed, the answer would be as early as possible, since an early audit is then as informative as a late one. During training, however, this relation drifts with the state of the models. A calibration obtained early can become stale, and a controller that consumes its budget on the first uncertain decisions cannot revise them later. At identical audit count, the timing of target feedback can matter as much as its amount.
blocks.zh: 接下来会出现第二个问题:审计何时应花? 如果确定代理和目标之间的关系,答案将尽可能早,因为早期审计与晚审计一样具有信息性。 然而,在培训期间,这种关系随模型的状态而变化。 早期获得的校正可能变得僵化,而控制者在最初不确定的决定上消耗其预算,不能在后期修改. 在相同的审计计数中,目标反馈的时间可能与其金额一样重要.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Choosing how much optimization budget each part of a training corpus receives has been studied under several names: data mixture optimization, curriculum learning, data selection, and online reweighting Saadi et al. (2026) . Offline mixture methods estimate a fixed allocation before the main run, often from a small proxy model: DoReMi uses excess loss relative to a reference model Xie et al. (2023) , DoGE uses gradient alignment with a generalization target Fan et al. (2024) , and RegMix or data mixing laws fit a predictor from proxy runs Liu et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2025) . Online methods revise the allocation during training: automated curricula and ODM cast the choice of task or domain as a bandit problem Graves et al. (2017) ; Albalak et al. (2023) , while Aioli and ADO estimate the marginal effect of each domain from training dynamics Chen et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2025) . Across these families, the utility signal is a proxy for the effect on the model of interest, and the residual error between this proxy and a higher-fidelity measurement is rarely modeled explicitly. Our work targets precisely this residual when it changes the allocation decision.

blocks.en: Multi-fidelity bandits combine cheap approximations with costly exact evaluations, typically assuming that the bias of each fidelity is bounded by a known constant and letting the learner choose the fidelity Kandasamy et al. (2016) . Bouneffouf et al. Bouneffouf et al. (2025) study a frequent noisy reward complemented by a sparse reliable one. They assume that the two means differ by the same offset for every arm, so both signals rank the arms in the same order. We allow the proxy–target mismatch to differ across arms, which can reverse their ranking. We estimate this mismatch from paired observations of both signals on the same pull. Our corrected estimator has the same form as the rectifier of prediction-powered inference Angelopoulos et al. (2023) and its active variants Zrnic and Candès (2024) . We use this estimator inside a sequential decision rule that also determines when to acquire costly target feedback. Variance-adaptive confidence bounds follow UCB-V Audibert et al. (2009) .

Our setting adds a second resource, the audit budget, whose consumption over time matters as much as its total: pacing rules that spread a hard budget over the remaining horizon are standard in online advertising Balseiro and Gur (2019) , and budgeted feedback relates to label-efficient prediction Cesa-Bianchi et al. blocks.zh: 在与 B → 6, 12, 30, 60, 150, 300 } B\in 6, 12, 30, 60, 150, 300 } 的平稳不匹配制度中, MC-Paced 的校正错误随着预算而减少, 从 0.0504 0.0504 在 B = 6 B = 6 到 0.0186 在 B = 150 B = 150 B = 150 的平稳绝对错误, 及其从 22.54 22.54 到 5.50 5.50 的后悔. 在很小的预算中,这种关系不是单调的:少数审计可以移动排名,而不会稳定排名。 B = 150 B = 150 B 和 B = 300 B = 300 之间,迟悔率仍然相当(5.50 5.50比 6.08 6.08),而总的迟悔率却不断下降,因此,在此环境中,对迟决定的额外审计的边际价值变得很小.

blocks.en: 6.2 CivilComments-WILDS Setup
blocks.zh: 6.2 公民评论-WILDS 设置

blocks.en: We instantiate the framework on CivilComments-WILDS, a binary toxicity classification benchmark Borkan et al. (2019) ; Koh et al. (2021) with identity annotations designed to study subpopulation shift. This choice does not reproduce the adaptation of a generative LLM. It provides a controllable closed loop in which data groups are interpretable, worst-group robustness is measurable, and two models of different capacity are actually trained on the same blocks. After cleaning, the training pool contains 266,224 examples.
blocks.zh: 我们即时分析CivilComments-WILDS的框架,这是Borkan等人(2019年);Koh等人(2021年)的二进制毒性分类基准,并附有身份说明,旨在研究亚人口变化。 这种选择不复制基因LLM的适应. 它提供了一个可控的闭路循环,其中数据组可被解释,最坏组稳健性可被测量,两个不同容量的模型实际上在同一个块上被训练. 清洗后,训练池有266,224个实例.

blocks.en: The action space, denoted B8, contains eight interventions corresponding to the identities male , female , LGBTQ , christian , muslim , other religions , black , and white . These groups overlap. Each block contains 512 examples: 256 drawn from the selected group, label-balanced (128 non-toxic and 128 toxic), and 256 drawn from the natural distribution of the pool. A block corresponds to 16 target updates.
blocks.zh: 行动空间表示B8包含8个与男性、女性、LGBTQ、克里斯蒂安、穆斯林、其他宗教、黑色和白色对应的干预。 这些小组重叠。 每个区块包含512个实例:256个取自所选组,标签平衡(128个无毒和128个有毒),256个取自池内自然分布. 一个块对应16个目标更新.

blocks.en: The target model is BERT-Large (24 layers, hidden size 1024, about 335M parameters) Devlin et al. (2019) . The proxy is BERT-Small (4 layers, hidden size 512, about 28.8M parameters) Turc et al. (2019) , selected by a preliminary scan over five BERT sizes (Appendix B ). The proxy reward is the decrease in class-balanced cross-entropy of BERT-Small on a fixed proxy validation set V proxy V_{\mathrm{proxy}} of 2,001 examples, measured every round. The target reward is the same quantity for BERT-Large on the full target validation set V target V_{\mathrm{target}} of 20,005 examples, with V proxy ⊂ V target V_{\mathrm{proxy}}\subset V_{\mathrm{target}} , measured only on audited rounds. The mismatch therefore combines a model gap and an evaluation-set gap.
blocks.zh: 目标模型为BERT-Large(24层,隐藏大小1024,参数约335M) Devlin等 (2019). 代理为BERT-Small(4层,隐藏大小512,约28.8M参数) . Turc等人(2019年),通过初步扫描在5个BERT大小上选中(附录B. 代理奖励是BERT-Small在固定代理验证集V代理V_{\mathrm{proxy}}2,001个例上,每轮测量的班级平衡交叉收缩. 目标奖励与BERT-Large在完全目标验证上的数量相同,设定为V目标V_{\mathrm{目标}}20,005例,而V代理目标V_{\mathrm{proxy}}\set V_{\mathrm{目标}}仅以被审计的回合来测量. 因此,这种不匹配将模型差距与评价设定差距结合起来。

blocks.en: The main metric is the worst-group accuracy (WGA) over the sixteen cells formed by the eight identities crossed with the two labels, denoted WGA-16 Sagawa et al. (2020) . Macro cross-entropy over the 16 identity-label cells (denoted CE in the tables) and overall accuracy are reported as guardrails. The controller never observes WGA: its target reward is a local cross-entropy gain, whereas WGA-16 measures the robustness of the final model. Trajectory metrics are computed on an independent validation set V val V_{\mathrm{val}} of 24,780 examples that never updates the controller. The official test set (133,782 examples) stays closed during development and is evaluated only on frozen checkpoints. All policies within a seed start from the same checkpoint, and methods that use target feedback share the same audit cap. Unlike the synthetic setting, the exact regret is not observable here, since counterfactual rewards of unplayed interventions are unknown. Policies are therefore compared through the state actually reached by the target model.
blocks.zh: 主要的衡量标准是,与两个标签相交叉的8个身份所形成的16个细胞的最差组精度(WGA),表示WGA-16 Sagawa等人(2020年)。 16个身份标签单元格(表格中注明的CE)的宏观横切,整体精确度作为护栏报告。 控制者从未遵守WGA:其目标奖励是局部的交叉性收益,而WGA-16则衡量最终模型的稳健性. 轨迹度量衡是在一个独立验证集V val V_{\mathrm{val}} 24,780个从未更新控制器的例子上计算出来的. 官方测试(133 782个实例)在开发期间一直关闭,只在被冻结的检查站进行评估。 种子内的所有政策都从同一个检查站开始,使用目标反馈的方法共享相同的审计上限. 与合成场景不同,这里没有看到确切的遗憾,因为没有被玩弄的干预的反事实回报是未知的. 因此,通过目标模式实际达到的状态对政策进行比较。

blocks.en: 6.3 Correction at Equal Target Budget
blocks.zh: 6.3 平等目标预算的校正

blocks.en: We first evaluate short late-stage adaptation. Both models start from a common checkpoint trained for about two epoch-equivalents, and the controlled phase adds only 0.12 to 0.25 epoch-equivalent. In these campaigns the corrected policy is MC-DUCB, which keeps the mismatch-corrected index but uses discounted statistics, as in discounted UCB Garivier and Moulines (2011) , and audits on a schedule fixed in advance instead of using the gate and pacing: after the first audit, each new audit is placed at the round that is farthest from the audits already scheduled, so that target feedback covers the whole phase (Appendix B ). MC-DUCB is not covered by the analysis of Section 5 : these campaigns test the correction principle, while Section 6.4 tests the gate and the pacing rule. It is compared with Static, a balanced round-robin over the eight interventions that receives no target feedback, Proxy-only, which decides from proxy rewards only, and Sparse-Target, which decides from the sparse target rewards alone and audits on the same schedule as MC-DUCB. In these campaigns, all policies use statistics discounted with a half-life of 64 rounds ( γ = 2 − 1 / 64 \gamma=2^{-1/64} ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价晚期的短期适应。 两种型号都从一个共同的检查站开始,为大约两个划时代的等同者训练,被控制的相位只增加了0.12到0.25个划时代的等同者. 在这些运动中,经更正的政策是MC-DUCB,它保持了不匹配的校正指数,但使用贴现的统计数据,如UCB Garivier和Moulines(2011年),并按照预先确定的时间安排进行审计,而不是使用大门和节奏:在第一次审计之后,每一次新的审计都置于与已排定的审计相去最远的一回合,因此目标反馈涵盖整个阶段(附录B)。 MC-DUCB不在第5节的分析范围之内:这些运动测试了改正原则,而第6.4节测试了大门和速度规则。 与Static相比,Static是一个平衡的回合循环,它与8项没有获得目标反馈的干预措施、仅由代理奖励决定的代理奖励和仅由很少目标奖励决定的Sparse-Target,以及按照MC-DUCB的同样时间表进行审计。 在这些运动中,所有政策都使用以64发半衰期为折扣的统计(γ = 2 − 1 / 64\gamma = 2^{ 1/64})。

blocks.en: H64 denotes a trajectory of 64 rounds, including 40 shared burn-in rounds, and target-aware policies may reveal B = 48 B=48 target rewards. During the burn-in, each of the eight interventions is played m 0 = 5 m_{0}=5 times in a balanced order. The budget counts every target reward revealed over the trajectory, burn-in included. H128 uses 128 rounds, including the same 40-round burn-in. For instance, B = 128 B=128 reveals the target reward at every round. Table 1 reports the final metrics. The contrast with Static ( + 1.57 +1.57 points, p Holm = 0.061 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.061 ) is suggestive only. The gain therefore does not come from more target information but from a different use of the same audits: the dense proxy provides temporal coverage and the audits correct its preferences. Consistently, the per-seed correlation between the mean residual of an intervention and its induced reallocation relative to Proxy-only is positive on all ten seeds, showing that the correction changes which interventions are played.

At the three budgets shared with Sparse-Target, MC-DUCB obtains a higher WGA-16 ( + 2.96 +2.96 , + 4.99 +4.99 , and + 1.51 +1.51 points at B = 16 B=16 , 32 32 , and 64 64 , see Table 2 ), and a lower cross-entropy at B = 16 B=16 and 32 32 . The best endpoint of the sweep is MC-DUCB at B = 32 B=32 (WGA-16 of .6985), above the dense configuration, MC-DUCB with B = 128 B=128 , which reveals the target reward at every round (.6905), and the relation between budget and final WGA is not monotone. With three seeds, we read this campaign as evidence that a moderate number of paired audits suffices, not as the identification of an optimal budget.

blocks.en: 6.4 Audit Timing under Long Training
blocks.zh: 6.4 长期培训的审计时间安排

blocks.en: We next run long trajectories in which the controller takes over from natural-distribution training at different stages. An epoch-equivalent is 520 blocks (8,320 target updates). All regimes end after two epoch-equivalents. They differ only by the natural prefix: the controller starts from the pretrained model (n0), after 0.25 epoch-equivalent (n25), or after one epoch-equivalent (n100), which gives 1,040, 910, and 520 controlled rounds. The audit cap is about 25% of the controlled rounds (260, 228, and 130 audits). Besides MC and MC-Paced, the long runs include Static, Proxy-DUCB (a discounted UCB on proxy rewards only), Sparse-Target, MC-DUCB, and MC-Paced-Forget, which is MC-Paced with discounted statistics as in discounted UCB Garivier and Moulines (2011) (half-life of 64 rounds, γ = 2 − 1 / 64 \gamma=2^{-1/64} ) and serves as an ablation of memory. Results are averaged over five paired seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来是长轨 控制器从不同阶段的自然分配训练中接手 一个划时代等同为520个块(8,320个目标更新). 所有政权在两个划时代的等同关系后结束. 它们仅因自然前缀而异:控制器从0.25个时间段等同(n25个)后预先训练的型号(n0个)起,或从一个时间段等同(n100个)后开始,它给出了1,040个,910个,520个受控弹. 审计上限约为受控轮数的25%(260、228和130个审计)。 除了MC和MC-Paced外,长跑包括了Static,Proxy-DUCB(仅以代理奖励折扣的UCB),Sparse-Target,MC-DUCB,和MC-Paced-Forget,后者以折扣的UCB Garivier和Moulines(2011年)(半衰期为64发,γ=2-1/64\gamma=2++-1/64}),并起到记忆分解的作用. 平均结果为五对种子。

blocks.en: On the audited rounds of MC-Paced, proxy and target rewards have a Pearson correlation of about 0.52, a Spearman correlation of about 0.45, and a sign agreement of about 66% in all three regimes. The proxy thus carries real high-frequency information, but about one third of the gains have opposite signs for the two models, which is the intermediate regime targeted by our formulation.
blocks.zh: 在经过审核的MC-Paced各轮中,代理和目标奖励的皮尔逊相关比例约为0.52分,斯皮尔曼相关比例约为0.45分,三个政权的标志性协议约为66%. 因此,这个代用词载有真正的高频信息,但大约三分之一的收益对两种模式有相反的征兆,而这两种模式是我们制定的目标中间机制。

blocks.en: We isolate the temporal component by comparing MC and MC-Paced, which share the proxy, the cumulative residual estimator, hard clipping, and the audit cap, and which end up consuming exactly the same number of audits. Table 3 shows that pacing improves test WGA-16 by + 6.32 +6.32 , + 7.20 +7.20 , and + 10.54 +10.54 points in n0, n25, and n100 (95% bootstrap CIs [ + 5.87 , + 6.94 ] [+5.87,+6.94] , [ + 5.90 , + 8.67 ] [+5.90,+8.67] , [ + 9.31 , + 11.77 ] [+9.31,+11.77] ), with gains on all five seeds in every regime. The independent validation set shows the same pattern ( + 7.76 +7.76 , + 7.67 +7.67 , + 12.60 +12.60 points). With five seeds, the evidence rests on effect size, seed-level consistency, and replication across the two evaluation sets rather than on an exact sign test.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较MC和MC-Paced来分离时间成分,它们共享代用,累积的剩余估计,硬剪接,以及审计上限,最终消耗的审计数量完全相同. 表3显示,节能改进了WGA-16的测试,增加了+6.32+6.32,+7.20+7.20,并增加了+10.54+10.54分的n0,n25,和n100(95%的靴子CIS[+5.87,+6.94] [+5.87,+6.94], [+5.90,+8.67], [+5.90,+8.67], [+9.31,+11.77] [+9.31,+11.77]),在每个政权中所有五个种子上都有收获. 独立验证集显示的规律相同(+7.76+7.76,+7.67+7.67,+12.60+12.60分). 有5个种子,证据取决于效果大小、种子水平的一致性以及两套评价的复制,而不是精确的标志测试。

blocks.en: Table 3: Official test set, mean over five paired seeds. MC and MC-Paced consume the same number of audits in each regime.
blocks.zh: 表3:官方测试组,指五对种子以上. MC和MC-Paced在每一制度中的审计次数相同。

blocks.en: Without pacing, MC meets enough uncertain decisions early to exhaust its cap at about 25% of the controlled phase, with a median audit at about 12.5%. MC-Paced spends the same number of audits but places its median audit at 42.6%, 41.2%, and 32.0% of the phase and its last audit at 99–100% (Figure 3 ). The allocation follows: the normalized entropy of the realized allocation is 0.39, 0.38, and 0.34 for MC, against 0.96, 0.96, and 0.94 for MC-Paced. A consistent interpretation is that a calibration built from early, still uncertain audits locks MC onto a few interventions, and that this decision cannot be revised once the budget is spent. Pacing reserves part of the target feedback budget for later stages, when the proxy–target relation may have drifted.
blocks.zh: 没有速度,MC提前满足足够的不确定决定,在受控阶段的25%左右用尽其上限,中值审计约为12.5%. MC-Paced的审计数量相同,但其中位数审计为42.6%、41.2%和32.0%,最近一次审计为99-100%(图3)。 拨款情况如下:已实现拨款的正反派为0.39、0.38和0.34;MC-Paced为0.96、0.96和0.94。 一种一致的解释是,从早期的、仍然不确定的审计建立起来的校正将MC锁定在少数干预措施上,一旦预算用完,这项决定就无法修改。 当代理-目标关系可能已经漂移时,将部分目标反馈预算留在后期。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Position of the audits within the controlled phase on CivilComments-WILDS. Circles mark the median audit and squares the last audit. Both methods consume the same cap. MC spends it in the first quarter of the phase, whereas MC-Paced keeps audits until the end.
blocks.zh: 图3:在Civil Comments-WILDS控制阶段的审计情况。 圆为中位数审计,平方为上个审计. 两种方法都消耗了相同的盖. MC在阶段的第一季度花费,而MC-Paced则将审计工作持续到结束.

blocks.en: Relative to MC, pacing raises the test accuracy of the toxic cells ( y = 1 y=1 ) by + 5.96 +5.96 , + 6.62 +6.62 , and + 7.98 +7.98 points while lowering that of the non-toxic cells by 3.7 to 4.5 points, at a cost of about 0.8 point of overall accuracy. The method thus trades part of the performance on already well-handled cells for robustness on the hardest ones. Adding exponential forgetting (half-life 64 rounds) on top of pacing does not help: it ends 0.17, 1.24, and 0.70 points of test WGA-16 below MC-Paced. In this benchmark, the robust component is the timing of the audits rather than an additional memory parameter.
blocks.zh: 相较于MC,相距相距会提高毒性细胞(y = 1 y = 1)的测试精度,比起5.96 + 5.96,+ 6.62 + 6.62,再比起7.98 + 7.98分,同时将无毒性细胞的测试精度降低3.7至 4.5分,成本约为0.8分的整体精度. 因此,该方法将部分性能取而代之的是已经处理得很好的细胞,而将强健性取而代之的是最困难的细胞。 将指数性遗忘(半衰期为64发)加到相距上也无济于事:它结束于0.17,1.24和MC-Paced下方为0.70分的试验WGA-16. 在这个基准中,强有力的组成部分是审计的时间,而不是额外的内存参数。

blocks.en: 6.5 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 6.5 与基线的比较

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 限制和结论

blocks.en: The proof of concept uses a pair of BERT models (Small and Large) on a classification benchmark rather than generative language models, eight interventions, and between three and ten seeds per campaign. The controller optimizes a local cross-entropy gain while we report worst-group accuracy, which measures a different property of the final model. The audit budget limits target information, not compute: the target model is trained on every block. The empirical comparison uses a single benchmark and baselines that isolate the components of the method (fixed allocation, proxy-only, target-only, and fixed-schedule correction). Comparisons with data allocation methods such as DoReMi, DoGE, or ODM Xie et al. (2023) ; Fan et al. (2024) ; Albalak et al. (2023) , and with Group DRO Sagawa et al. (2020) for worst-group robustness, are left to an extended version. On the theoretical side, the guarantee under change covers abrupt, piecewise-stationary changes and a sliding-window policy whose window is tuned with the number of changes. The experiments run its cumulative and discounted counterparts, MC-Paced and MC-Paced-Forget, and smooth drift is covered only empirically. All upper bounds assume known noise scales.
blocks.zh: 概念的证明在分类基准上使用一对BERT模型(小型和大型),而不是基因语言模型,8个干预,每次选取3到10个种子. 控制器在报告最坏组精度的同时,优化了本地的交叉进取,这可以测量最终模型的不同属性. 审计预算限制目标信息,不计算:每个区块都训练目标模型. 经验比较采用单一的基准和基线,将方法的各个组成部分隔离开来(固定分配,只使用代理,只使用目标,以及固定时间表的校正). 与DoReMi,DoGE,或ODM Xie等(2023年);Fan等(2024年);Albalak等(2023年);以及Group DRO Sagawa等(2020年)最差组稳健性的数据分配方法的比较,留待扩展版. 在理论方面,变化中的保证包括突然的、片面的固定变化和滑窗政策,其窗口与变化的次数相适应。 实验运行其累积和折扣的对应物MC-Paced和MC-Paced-Forget,平滑漂移仅以实证方式被覆盖. 所有上界假设已知噪声尺度.

blocks.en: A small model can guide the data allocation of a larger one while ranking the data differently. Paired audits make this arm-dependent mismatch identifiable, and a mismatch-corrected bandit uses them to repair the proxy ranking. When the relation between the two models is stationary, audits are best spent as soon as the gate requests them. When this relation changes, a policy that has already exhausted its audit budget cannot detect a later change from proxy feedback alone. Pacing combined with a sliding window reaches the rate of sliding-window UCB. The experiments show that, at identical audit count, the timing of audits matters as much as their number. Natural next steps are an evaluation of the sliding-window policy, windows that adapt to an unknown number of changes, variance-adaptive confidence radii that do not require known noise scales, and experiments on language model data mixing.
blocks.zh: 一个小模型可以指导一个较大的模型的数据分配,同时对数据进行不同的排序. 派尔德审计使得这种依赖手臂的错配可以识别,一个不匹配修正后被强盗利用来修复代理排名. 当两种模式之间的关系固定时,只要闸口提出要求,就最好花掉审计。 当这种关系发生变化时,一项已经用尽其审计预算的政策不能仅从代理反馈中发现后来的变化。 与滑动窗口相配合的平滑达到滑动窗口UCB的速度. 实验显示,在相同的审计计数中,审计的时间安排与其数量一样重要. 接下来的自然步骤是对滑动-窗口政策的评价,适应未知数量变化的窗口,不需要已知噪声尺度的差异-适应性置信度,以及语言模型数据混合的实验.

blocks.en: Static is a balanced round-robin over the eight interventions and receives no target feedback. Proxy-only (H64, H128) and Proxy-DUCB (long runs) decide from proxy rewards only with a discounted UCB rule. Sparse-Target, called Gold-only in the H64 campaign, decides from the sparse target rewards alone. MC-DUCB uses the mismatch-corrected index with discounted statistics. Dense-Target denotes MC-DUCB with a budget equal to the horizon, so that the target reward is revealed at every round. Natural denotes training on the natural distribution of the pool. In the H64 and H128 campaigns, all statistics are discounted with weight 2 − ( t − s ) / 64 2^{-(t-s)/64} for an observation from round s s .

blocks.en: Sparse-Target and MC-DUCB audit on a schedule fixed before the run by a farthest-point rule. The first post-warm-up audit takes place at the first round after the warm-up and the second at the last round. Each subsequent audit is placed at the round that maximizes the distance to the nearest audit already scheduled, that is, in the middle of the largest remaining gap. For instance, with T = 2000 T=2000 and a warm-up of 40 rounds, the first three audits fall at rounds 41, 2000, and about 1020. Target feedback is thus spread over the whole phase, refined by successive halving.
blocks.zh: Sparse-Talget和MC-DUCB按运行前按最远点规则固定的时间表进行审计. 冬季后期的第一次审计在保温后第一轮进行,第二轮在上一轮进行. 以后的每一次审计都放在最接近已排定审计的一回合,即最相差最大的剩余缺口中间。 例如,随着T = 2000 T = 2000,以及40轮的热身,前三次审计分别是41轮、2000轮和约1020轮。 因此,目标反馈分散在整个阶段,通过连续减半加以完善。

blocks.en: At round t t , the intervention A t A_{t} and the audit decision Q t Q_{t} are chosen before the current feedback is observed. The proxy reward may update the controller at every round, whereas the target reward updates it only when Q t = 1 Q_{t}=1 . Metrics computed on the independent validation set V val V_{\mathrm{val}} are never fed back to the controller and serve only to reconstruct trajectories of cross-entropy, WGA-16, and accuracy. Counterfactual scans used to analyze the mechanism are likewise diagnostic only. The official test set remained closed during development and method selection.
blocks.zh: 在 t 回合中,在遵守当前反馈之前,选择了干预 A t A_{t} 和审计决定 Q t t}。 代理奖励可以在每个回合更新控制器,而目标奖励只有在Q t = 1 Q_{t}= 1 时才会更新. 在独立验证集V val V_{\ mathrm{val}}}上计算出的量子从未被反馈到控制器上,仅用于重建跨内线,WGA-16的轨迹和准确性. 用于分析机制的反事实扫描同样只是诊断。 在开发和方法选择期间,官方测试集仍然关闭。

blocks.en: Comparisons between policies are paired by seed: within a regime, all methods start from the same state and follow the same data-construction conventions, so that differences isolate the effect of the allocation policy. Long runs are checkpointed so that they can be resumed exactly: model weights, optimizer states, controller state, round counters, and remaining audit budget are restored jointly, since an incorrect resumption could alter both the trajectory of the model and the information available to the controller. All complementary test evaluations were performed on checkpoints frozen before the test set was opened, and no training, tuning, or checkpoint selection was performed after observing them.
blocks.zh: 政策间的比较由种子对接:在一个制度内,所有方法都从同一状态起步并遵循相同的数据构建惯例,这样差异就孤立了分配政策的效果. 长跑被检查,以便可以准确恢复:模型加权,优化状态,控制器状态,圆计数器,剩余审计预算被联合恢复,因为不正确的恢复既会改变模型的轨迹,也会改变控制器掌握的信息. 所有补充测试评价都是在测试组开通前被冻结的检查站进行的,观察后没有进行培训、调整或选择检查站。

blocks.en: Ethical Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en: CivilComments-WILDS contains toxic comments and identity annotations. We use it only to study worst-group robustness of toxicity classifiers. No new data were collected. Improving the worst identity group comes with a measurable trade-off: relative to MC, MC-Paced lowers the accuracy of non-toxic cells by 3.7 to 4.5 points, which should be weighed before deployment.
blocks.zh: Civil Comments- WILDS 包含有毒的评论和身份说明. 我们只用它来研究毒性分类器最坏组的强性。 没有收集新的数据。 改善最差的特征组需要一种可衡量的权衡:相对于MC,MC-Paced将无毒细胞的精度降低3.7至4.5分,在部署前应进行权衡.
